mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level (below historical average) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (historical 25th percentile) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate increase above 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a sharp contraction in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases (i.e., the return is positive in >50% of such periods over a 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a rising unemployment rate above 4.5% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, UNRATE > 4.5% fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases (i.e., positive returns occur in >50% of such periods).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (2017 base) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases (i.e., the return is positive in >60% of such periods).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS level fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases (i.e., the return is negative in >60% of periods when RSAFS is above the 75th percentile).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates severe labor market stress, reducing consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases (i.e., the return is positive in >50% of such periods).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden federal funds rate increase above 5.2% within a month signals immediate monetary tightening, causing short-term equity volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5.2% fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases (i.e., the return is positive in >60% of such periods).
